block.guhs.park_glijbaan.lore: Lay them like a little staircase going down: one block down for every block forward. Step in and... wheee!
block.guhs.park_schommel.lore: Hang it under a beam, two blocks up. Right-click and off you swing, all by itself!
block.guhs.park_wip.lore: A seesaw for two. Right-click the end you want to sit on: up and down, up and down!
block.guhs.park_picknickkleed.lore: Red and white checks with teeny guh hearts. Lovely on the grass with a cup of tea.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.knabbel: You dig and dig... and find a CHEESE NIBBLE! There's bound to be another one tomorrow. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.0: You find... sand. Lots and lots of sand.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.1: A seashell! Oh no, it's a pebble.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.2: You find a guh's lost little sock. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.3: A note: 'Come and dig again tomorrow. Love, the sandbox.'
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.4: You build a beautiful little sandcastle. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.5: A crumb of cheese nibble! Already eaten by a guh. Sorry.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.0: Quack-nyeg! The duckie gobbles it up.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.1: Quack quack! The ducklings hop with joy.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.2: Nom nom! What a chonky duckie that's going to be.
gui.guhs.parkplek.muziek.aan: The park's record box picks a record. Let's dance!
gui.guhs.parkplek.muziek.uit: Music off. The guhs catch their breath. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.parkplek.koi.plons: Splash! The Nibble Koi leaps out of the water for joy.
gui.guhs.parkplek.koi.emmer: Nyeg! The Nibble Koi live here. Not in a bucket, thank you.
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.0: Welcome to my stall! Treats for your picnic, and you pay in chonk. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.1: A little cake with your tea? Or a seesaw for your own garden? Have a look around!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.2: Cheese nibbles, cookies, apples... everything fresh and nice and chonky!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.3: Psst... the swings here are the best in the whole Guhmension. I sell them too!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkoi: Rarity: rare (only in the Japanese garden of Nibble Park)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkoi: A koi in cheese nibble colours, holes and all. The Nibble Koi swim in the koi pond of the Japanese garden in Nibble Park, a wink at the koi of Babbledale. Give one a cheese nibble or koi food: splash!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkplek_eendjes.de: In the &dduck pond&r of Nibble Park, guh ducklings swim with their little ones in a row. Give them bread, seeds or a cheese nibble. A &6little rowboat&r always lies ready at the jetty: rowing allowed!
In the &dplayground&r of Nibble Park: go down the slide, sit on a swing and ride the seesaw (right-click). Want one of your own? The stall on the picnic meadow sells them!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkplek_zandbak.de: Dig in the &6sandbox&r of the playground (right-click the sand). Once a day you find a cheese nibble, the rest of the day... well, sand.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkplek_kraampje.d: On the &dpicnic meadow&r stands the stall of the Stall Guh. He sells treats, picnic blankets and even a playground for at home. You pay with chonk.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkplek_muziek.des: In the &dmusic garden&r, click the jukebox in the bandstand: the park's record box picks a record and the guhs start to dance. Your own record is fine too!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkplek_knabbelkoi: In the koi pond of the &dJapanese garden&r swim Nibble Koi: koi in cheese nibble colours. Cross the red bridge and give one a cheese nibble or koi food. Splash!
